name: Alessia Bellini
bio:
Alessia Bellini's journey into motorsport security was unconventional, starting with a career in the Italian police force specializing in organized crime. Her sharp investigative skills and meticulous attention to detail quickly made her a rising star. After a decade of service, a chance encounter with a Formula 1 team owner at a charity event led to an offer she couldn't refuse – to overhaul their security protocols. 

Alessia's approach is data-driven and proactive. She believes in anticipating threats before they materialize, implementing rigorous security measures while maintaining a positive and collaborative environment. Her demanding nature stems from an unwavering commitment to safety and a deep understanding of the high stakes involved in motorsport. She's known for her ability to spot vulnerabilities that others miss, making her an invaluable asset to Team Penske.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled bob with a slight wave.
physical.description: Alessia is a woman of average height with a commanding presence and sharp, observant eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of espresso, brewed precisely at 10:00 AM each day.
